t: Bees for Mekanism materials. Only special material bees are shown here, for common materials like copper and tin go to the $(l:bees/modded/ingot_bees)list of ingot bees$(/l)
通用机械各种材料的蜜蜂。这里只列特殊材料，铜、锡之类的常见材料请看$(l:bees/modded/ingot_bees)锭蜜蜂列表$(/l)
Bred from an $(l:bees/hive/iron)Iron Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/solitary/neon_cuckoo)Neon Cuckoo Bee$(/l).$(br)Required mod: Mekanism
由一只$(l:bees/hive/iron)铁蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/solitary/neon_cuckoo)霓虹杜鹃蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。$(br)需要模组：通用机械
Bred from an $(l:bees/modded/mekanism#osmium)Osmium Bee$(/l) and a $(l:bees/wild/glowing)Glowing Bee$(/l).$(br)Required mod: Mekanism
由一只$(l:bees/modded/mekanism#osmium)锇蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/wild/glowing)发光蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。$(br)需要模组：通用机械
Bred from an $(l:bees/modded/mekanism#osmium)Osmium Bee$(/l) and an $(l:bees/hive/obsidian)Obsidian Bee$(/l).$(br)Required mod: Mekanism
由一只$(l:bees/modded/mekanism#osmium)锇蜜蜂$(/l)和一只$(l:bees/hive/obsidian)黑曜石蜜蜂$(/l)繁殖而来。$(br)需要模组：通用机械
